  · simp
  exact ae_of_all μ hf

    ∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ := by
  rw [← setLIntegral_univ, ← setLIntegral_congr]; rwa [ae_eq_univ]
